lines.zh: 我扑扇着小翅膀，飞得不高
lines.en: I flap my small wings, not flying high

lines.zh: 我的鳞片泛着下界的光
lines.en: My scales hold a Nether sheen

lines.zh: 我落在地上，用爪子走两步
lines.en: I land and take two steps on my claws

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚后跟，别踩我。
lines.en: Right at your heels, do not step on me.

lines.zh: 诡异色的尾巴，卷了一下。
lines.en: My warped-colored tail curls once.

lines.zh: 小家伙仰着头，够不到你的脸。
lines.en: The little one looks up, too short to reach your face.
I circle to your other side

lines.zh: 我小小的，翅膀比身体大
lines.en: I'm small, with wings too big for me
My claws slip on the black stone
I wait for you — don't fall behind

lines.zh: 我的爪子在沙上留下痕
lines.en: My claws leave marks in the sand

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿飞了一段
lines.en: I fly a stretch along your leg
I shake the ash off my wings

lines.zh: 我发出一声细细的尖音
lines.en: I let out a thin pip
I crouch in your shadow

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收起来，像斗篷
lines.en: My wings fold like a cloak
I blink slowly, my eyes bright
I rest my head on my claws

lines.zh: 我在听下界之外的声音
lines.en: I listen to sounds outside the Nether

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里滚了一点火声
lines.en: A little fire sound rolls in my throat
I lift my head and sniff
My tail draws circles behind me
I wait for you to say something
I smell like smoke
I shiver along the spine
I spread my wings and fold them
The wind here is dry

lines.zh: 我打了个小喷嚏，冒了点火星
lines.en: I sneeze a little spark
I look up and keep looking

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的头转到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, my head turns
I know the way you reach for me
You crouch and I come close

lines.zh: 我歪头看你手里的指环
lines.en: I tilt my head at the ring in your hand
I nudge your sleeve
Are you leaving
I wait in your shadow

lines.zh: 你说话的时候我会歪头
lines.en: I tilt my head when you speak
I remember you hatched me

lines.zh: 你把手指伸过来，我闻了闻
lines.en: You offer a finger and I sniff it

lines.zh: 我轻轻咬了一下，没有用力
lines.en: I bite gently, without pressure
I sprawl flat at your feet
Do you understand my call
I wait for you to pat my head

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕在你靴子上
lines.en: I curl my tail around your boot
I cry out and curl up
I shrink back to your heels
One wing is bent
I shake and get up
I look up at you as if asking
I flatten down
A little fire sound in my throat
I press against your leg
I don't dare charge again
I get up on my claws
What's in your hand is warm
I like that smell
I stretch my neck. Still short.
Give me a little

lines.zh: 我闻着像火，可我不吃火
lines.en: It smells of fire, but I don't eat fire
The warmth of your palm
I press close to warm my claws
My snout nuzzles your pocket
I take it in small bites
I lick my lips when I'm done
You bump me and I nearly tip
I grab your trouser leg
You kick me off to one side
I land and scramble up
My wing hits you
I slip between your legs

lines.zh: 我翅膀还软，一撞就翻过去。
lines.en: My wings are soft; one bump flips me.
I steady myself against your foot
I get clear, then come back
I won't be angry
I rest my head on your knee

lines.zh: 我把最暖的地方让给你
lines.en: I give you the warmest spot
I cover your hand with a wing
We watch the fire together

lines.zh: 我的尾巴搭在你的靴上
lines.en: My tail lies across your boot
I call out, small
You stroke my back and I close my eyes
Neither of us needs to speak
I've memorized this scent
I plan to follow you always
I hold it under both claws
I take it up; it's a little hot
I bring it to your hand
It's heavier than I am
I carry it back to my nest
It fell; I snatch it up

lines.zh: 下界孵出来的，鳞是紫的。
lines.en: Hatched in the Nether, scales violet.
I hide it under my wing
I'll keep this
I push it to your feet
Something's coming near you
I spread my wings and stand in front
I let out a low growl at it
My scales have risen

lines.zh: 我认得出那不是好东西
lines.en: I know that's nothing good
I glance back at you
I'm ready to pounce
I'm smaller than you, but I go first
Fire rolls in my throat
I shriek at it
Just shift back half a step
I hold this side
I hunker my small body lower
I won't let it pass
I circle to its flank
It shifts and I answer at once
My wings beat up sparks
I'm small and quick; it can't catch me
I spit a little flame
I come back in front of you
It tries to pass; I block
I keep calling
I hear you behind me
Another puff of flame
My claws dig in
It's starting to slow
My tail goes stiff and straight
I wait for you to join
Now, I go in
I bite into the back of its neck
I spit a small ball of flame
My claws rake its hide

lines.zh: 这一下把它的注意拉过来了
lines.en: That pulls its attention to me
I roll twice before finding my feet
I lunge once more
I bite its leg and hold
My wings beat at its eyes
That bite misses
I roll off its back

lines.zh: 我还不大，可我的牙很尖
lines.en: I'm small, but my teeth are sharp
I retreat to your side
My thin tail whips once
I'll lunge once more
The shell splits at my feet
I shake off the film
I beat my wings for the first time
Nether air rushes in
I raise my small head to you
I call, thin and bright
Sparks fall from the corner of my mouth
My scales aren't hard yet
I stumble once, then get up again

lines.zh: 我这么小，先学会喷火星。
lines.en: Small as I am, I have learned to spit sparks.
I'm the size of your palm
I crawl out of the shell
I lift my head and sniff
I crawl toward your hand

lines.zh: 我身上还带着蛋的温度
lines.en: I'm still warm from the egg
I rest my head on your finger
I sneeze out a flame

lines.zh: 我张嘴，只发出小小的声音
lines.en: I open my mouth and only a small sound comes

lines.zh: 火对我不算伤，可我还是烫
lines.en: Fire isn't my death, but it still burns

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，翅膀没撑住
lines.en: I fall from height and my wings fail
Water makes my wings heavy
The blast flings me far

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的翅膀
lines.en: An arrow shoots clean through my wing

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的鳞片发凉
lines.en: That force chills my scales
I'm hungry, and my fire is small

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的火全灭了
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my fire goes out

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我拍着翅膀
lines.en: Nothing below; I beat my wings
